notes.title: Update notes for 25/06/2024 - Version 1.3
notes.content:
Hello Drivers! An update for the workforce to fix a few issues that have been affecting our drivers work/life balance.


 Fixed 2 issues with the “Fill Er’ Up” achievement
 Panic is now only reduced by petting Acerola
 Increased panic gains from all sources
 Cleaned up some edge cases where passengers would have the wrong lines
 Verified all achievements are functional
 “Nope” achievement can now be gained from any ending except “You’re Fired”

We’d recommend checking out the community guides for help on some of the trickier achievements.

Also, stay tuned for other projects on our social media pages. Cool things are coming soon! Twitter or Tiktok
